aboutSubtitle: Muryarka. Gaskiyarka. An raba da Tsabta.
missionPara1: A zamanin deepfakes, ɓatar da bayanai, da ikon tsakiya, VocalWitness yana maido da filin jama'a. Mun yi imani cewa gaskiya ba a ba da umarni daga algorithms ko masu kula ba — ana nuna ta, ana shaida, kuma jama'a ke tabbatar da ita.
missionPara2: Muna ba kowane ɗan ƙasa ikon raba shaidu na asali, media na bincike, da abubuwan da suka faru da kayan aikin tsabtar cryptograph, yayin da muke kare sirri da adawa da magudi.
forensicIntegrityDesc: Hotuna da rikodin murya suna karɓar hashing na cryptograph. Tabbatarwa mai ci-gaba (ciki har da hujjojin Zero-Knowledge da ake haɓakawa) tana taimakawa wajen kafa sahihanci ba tare da bayyana asalin ka ba.
privacyFirstDesc: Asalin ka yana ci gaba da kariya. Muna amfani da tabbatar da waya, tsarin suna, da fasahar kiyaye sirri don ka iya yin magana da ƙarfi yayin da kake cikin tsaro.
communityStewardshipDesc: Babu wata ƙungiya guda da ke sarrafa labari. Ana samun aminci ta hanyar shiga cikin gaskiya. Shaidu da aka Tabbatar da tsarin suna suna ba da lada ga tsabta.
communitySupportedDesc: Ana ba da kuɗi gaba ɗaya ta hanyar tallafin son rai da gudummawar mutane da suka yi imani da tsarin bayanai mai lafiya. Babu bangon biyan kuɗi. Babu fasalolin premium da aka kulle a bayan biyan kuɗi.
trustStep1Desc: Fara a matsayin Ɗan Ƙasa kuma ka sami matakan aminci mafi girma ta hanyar tabbatar da waya da gudummawar gaskiya. Yanayin Muryar Shaida yana ba da mafi ƙarfin garantin cryptograph.
trustStep2Desc: Duk media ana sa wa hatimin lokaci da hash. Littafin Shaida yana kiyaye rubutu na dindindin da za a iya tabbatarwa na abin da aka raba.
trustStep3Title: 3. Rarraba Ba tare da Magudi ba
trustStep3Desc: Muna aiki sosai a matsayin filin jama'a da hanyar rarraba tsaka-tsaki. Ba mu gyara, ƙara ƙarfi, ko danne abun ciki ba sai dai don aiwatar da buƙatun tsaro da shari'a na asali.
aboutQuote: "A zamanin hayaniya, murya mafi haske ita ce wacce za ta iya tabbatar da cewa ba a canza ta ba."
footerCopyright: © 2026 VocalWitness • An Gina don Gaskiya • Shaida • Filin Jama'a
privacyIntro: A VocalWitness, mun yi imani cewa gaskiya bai kamata ta buƙaci sadaukar da sirri ba. Mun sadaukar da rage tattara bayanai yayin da muke kiyaye tsabtar filin jama'a.
privacySection1Text: Muna amfani da fasahohin kiyaye sirri (ciki har da hujjojin Zero-Knowledge inda ake samu) don ka iya shiga cikin ma'ana yayin da kake kare asalin ka. Ba mu sayar da bayanan masu amfani ba. Ba mu shiga cikin talla na sa ido ba.
privacySection2Title: 2. Bayanan da Ba Mu Tattara ba
privacyNotCollect1: Katunan shaida na gwamnati, fasfo, ko bayanan biomitiri
privacyNotCollect2: Bin diddigin wuri na ainihi na lokaci-lokaci
privacyNotCollect3: Cikakken zanen zamantakewar ka ko jerin lambobin sirri
privacyNotCollect4: Bayanan kuɗi (sai dai rubutun gudummawar son rai)
privacyAccountInfoDesc: Imel ko lambar waya (don tabbatarwa), sunan mai amfani da aka zaɓa, da bayanan asali na bayanin martaba da ka bayar.
privacyContentDesc: Shaidu, hotuna, rikodin murya, da bayanan da suka danganci (misali, hatimin lokaci, hashes na cryptograph).
privacyVerificationDesc: Matsayin tabbatar da waya da hujjojin Zero-Knowledge (inda aka aiwatar). Ba mu adana bayanan sirri na asali ba.
privacyTechnicalDesc: Ƙididdigar amfani da ba a san suna ba, adireshin IP (na ɗan lokaci don tsaro), da bayanan na'ura don hana spam/cin zarafi.
privacyUse1: Don samar da, kiyaye, da haɓaka dandamali
privacyUse2: Don kunna fasalolin aminci (tabbatar da waya, hujjojin ZK, suna)
privacyUse3: Don aiwatar da Sharuɗɗan Sabis ɗinmu da Jagororin Tsaro
privacyUse4: Don amsa buƙatun shari'a lokacin da doka ta buƙaci
privacySection5Text: Za ka iya goge asusunka a kowane lokaci, wanda zai cire bayanin martabarka da abun ciki da ba a buga ba. Duk da haka, abun ciki da aka riga aka buga a Filin Jama'a ya zama wani ɓangare na rubutu na dindindin (kamar magana ta jama'a) kuma ba za a iya goge shi gaba ɗaya ba.
privacySection6Text: Inda aka aiwatar, hujjojin ZK suna ba mu damar tabbatar da cewa mai amfani ya cika wasu sharuɗɗa (misali, ɗan adam ne, ya kai matakin aminci) ba tare da adana ko bayyana bayanan sirri masu mahimmanci ba.
privacySection7Text: Muna amfani da Firebase (Google) don tabbatarwa, bayanan ajiya, da ajiya. Bayananka suna da kariya a ƙarƙashin ƙa'idodinsu na tsaro. Ba mu raba bayanan sirri da wasu ƙungiyoyi don manufofin tallace-tallace ba.
privacyImportant: Muhimmanci: Shaidu na jama'a suna bayyane ga kowa. Muna ba da shawara sosai cewa kada ka taɓa buga bayanan sirri masu mahimmanci waɗanda za su iya jefa tsaron ka cikin haɗari.
termsIntro: Barka da zuwa VocalWitness — filin jama'a da ƴan ƙasa ke gudanarwa don gaskiya, shaida, da shaida. Ta hanyar amfani da dandamali ɗinmu, ka yarda da waɗannan Sharuɗɗan Sabis.
termsSection1Text: Ta hanyar shiga ko amfani da VocalWitness, ka yarda ka ɗaure da waɗannan Sharuɗɗa bisa doka. Idan ba ka yarda ba, kada ka yi amfani da dandamali.
termsSection2Text: VocalWitness yana aiki a matsayin hanyar rarraba da ba a yi magudi ba — filin jama'a inda ƴan ƙasa za su iya raba shaidu da shaida. Ba mu ƙirƙiri ba, ba mu amince da abun ciki ba, kuma ba mu yi aiki a matsayin kotu ba.
termsSection3Intro: Muna amfani da tsarin aminci mai yawa don ƙarfafa ingancin magana:
termsTier1: Maganar Ɗan Ƙasa — Buɗe ga duk masu amfani (rajista na asali).
termsTier2: Da'irar Aminci — An buɗe ta hanyar tabbatarwa.
termsTier3: Muryar Shaida — Mataki mafi girma, ana samun shi ta hanyar shiga akai-akai da tabbatarwa mai ci-gaba (ciki har da hujjojin Zero-Knowledge inda aka aiwatar).
termsTierNote: Matakai mafi girma suna buɗe manyan alhaki da iyawa (misali, ƙirƙirar ƙungiya, bayyanar mafi girma).
termsConduct1: Kai kaɗai ke da alhakin duk abun ciki da ka buga.
termsConduct2: Dole ne ka raba abun ciki da ka yi imani da gaskiya kuma ka yi aiki da niyyar kyau.
termsConduct3: Kada ka buga abun ciki na doka, ɓatanci, cin zarafi, tashin hankali, ƙiyayya, ko cin zarafin jima'i.
termsConduct4: Kada ka yi magudi da shaida ko ka yi kamar wasu mutane.
termsSection5Text: Kana riƙe da cikakken mallakar abun ciki ɗinka. Ta hanyar bugawa a VocalWitness, kana ba mu lasisi na duniya, ba na keɓance ba, ba tare da kuɗi ba, na dindindin don ɗauka, nuna, rarraba, da adana abun ciki ɗinka a dandamali da madubinsa.
termsSection6Text: Masu amfani za su iya ƙirƙira ko shiga Ƙungiyoyi da hanyoyin sadarwa na sirri dangane da matakin amincinsu. Masu ƙirƙira ƙungiya da masu kulawa suna da alhakin aiwatar da ƙa'idodin al'umma a cikin wuraren su. VocalWitness yana riƙe da haƙƙin shiga cikin shari'o'in manyan laifuffuka.
termsSection7Text: VocalWitness ana tallafa masa gaba ɗaya ta hanyar gudummawar son rai na al'umma, asusun tallafi na gaskiya, da gudummawar cryptograph kai tsaye ba tare da ajiya ba. Ba a mayar da gudummawa ba kuma ba su ba da haƙƙoƙin mulki na musamman ko mallaka a kan dandamali ba.
termsSection8Text: VocalWitness da masu kula da shi sun ƙi alhaki don abun ciki da masu amfani suka ƙirƙira, rushewar hanyar sadarwa, ko gazawar tabbatarwa ta cryptograph ta waje.
ledgerIntegrityTitle: Tsabtar Littafi & Rashin Canzawa a Matakin Aikace-aikace
ledgerIntegrityPara1: Da zarar an rubuta rubutu a Littafin Bincike ko log na bincike, dokokin aikace-aikace da bayanan ajiya suna sa ya zama ba zai yiwu ba ga kowane mai amfani (ko mai aiki na yau da kullum) ya gyara ko ya goge shi.
ledgerIntegrityPoint1: Dokokin tsaro na Firestore sun haramta sabuntawa da goge a kan tarin littafi.
ledgerIntegrityPoint2: Hashing na SHA-256 na gefen abokin ciniki na media da abun ciki.
ledgerIntegrityPoint3: Haɗa hashes na shigarwar bincike (kowace shigarwa tana ƙunshe da hash na cryptograph na wanda ya gabata).
ledgerIntegrityClarification: Bayani mai muhimmanci: Wannan rashin canzawa ne a matakin aikace-aikace. Ba cikakken blockchain na jama'a ba ne. Bayanan suna rayuwa a Firebase / Google Cloud. Dokoki da cryptograph suna sa canje-canje na sirri su zama da wahala sosai, amma aminci na ƙarshe har yanzu yana dogara da gaskiyar mai aiki da tsabtar mai bayar da sabis na girgije.
ledgerIntegrityFuture: Ƙarfafawa na zaɓi da aka tsara (abun Batch 1 na 3): ana iya fitar da hashes na cryptograph na lokaci-lokaci na littafi kuma a ƙulla su a IPFS da/ko a ɗaure su a hankali a kan sarkar jama'a (Polygon ko Base). Wannan ba a kunna ba tukuna.
